head.readNote: The production manager gives orders to teams. You see the team of each order; on an order you can ask for another team.
head.info: One column a team, and one for the orders that have no team yet. A card opens the order. The numbers are for a team, never for one person: small teams show no numbers. The customer sees no team.

site.choose: Teams work on one site. Choose the site:

lend.title: Lend {name}
lend.body: The home team stays. After the last day the person is back in it. The history keeps who lent whom, until when and why.

held.noLine: This team has no line: a loan needs a line for now.
held.day: Choose a last day from today, at most {count} days.
held.reason: Say why the person is lent.

refusal.LEFT: This person has left: they are lent to no team.
refusal.LINE_NOT_OF_SITE: The team's line is not of the person's site.
refusal.TEAM_OTHER_SITE: The team is of another site.
refusal.TEAM_OTHER_LINE: The team works on another line.
refusal.LOAN_OVERLAP: The person is already lent in those days: one loan at a time.

privacy: The numbers here are for a team, never for one person. The customer sees no team.
failed: The teams could not be read.

error.write: It was not saved. Try again.
error.offline: No answer from the factory: check the network and try again.
error.notFound: It is not there any more.
error.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again. Check it and try again.
error.invalid: It was refused as it is: check what you chose.
